title: Piwigo theme manifest
description: Declarative manifest for Piwigo 17+ themes. One file per theme at themes/<id>/theme.json. Read by ThemeRegistry at load time; validated via opis/json-schema.

$schema.description: URI pointing at this schema for IDE/editor autocomplete. Optional; not enforced.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must match the theme directory basename.

name.description: Human-readable theme name shown in the admin UI.

version.description: Theme version — SemVer or PEM-revision-string (e.g. '1.4.0', '2.0', '1.0.0-beta.1', '1.0+r42'). Up to 4 dot-separated numeric segments: the bundled 'modus' theme's own real version is '16.3.0.1'.

description.description: Single-line description shown in the admin UI.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. 'GPL-3.0-or-later', 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0'). Required — this fork rejects themes distributed without a license.

minPiwigo.description: Minimum Piwigo version this theme targets, matching Core\AppInfo::VERSION's own 3-part shape (e.g. '16.3.0') — see plugin.schema.json's own minPiwigo description for why this isn't a 'MAJOR.MINOR' branch marker.

hasSettings.description: Whether the theme exposes a settings page: true (admin), false (none), or 'webmaster' (webmaster-only). Default: false.

require.description: Map of dependency names to composer-style version constraints. Keys are 'piwigo' for core, 'plugin/<id>' for a plugin, or 'theme/<id>' for another theme.

psr-4.description: PSR-4 namespace prefix to directory map, relative to the theme root.

autoload.description: Autoload configuration for the theme's source files.

parent.description: Parent theme id for inheritance. Omit for a root theme with no parent.

loadParentCss.description: Whether the parent theme's CSS loads before this theme's own CSS. Default: false.

loadParentLocalHead.description: Whether the parent theme's own localHead fragment also loads. Default: same as loadParentCss (no bundled theme sets this separately today).

assets.description: Map of asset kind to directory, relative to the theme root.

localHead.description: Path to a template fragment injected into the page <head>, relative to the theme root. Omit if the theme has none.

colorscheme.description: Picks a CSS variant in standard_pages/batch-manager templates. Omit when the theme inherits its colorscheme from its parent.

useStandardPages.description: Whether this theme opts into the standard_pages auth-page redirect. No bundled theme sets this today; reserved for third-party themes. Default: false.

iconDir.description: Root-relative path to this theme's icon assets (e.g. 'themes/default/icon'). Omit to inherit the parent theme's value -- most themes with a parent leave this unset.

adminIconDir.description: Root-relative path to this admin theme's own icon assets (e.g. 'themes/admin/default/icon'), distinct from 'iconDir' -- admin themes commonly set 'iconDir' to the gallery theme's icon path (for a shared favicon) while needing their own separate icon set for in-page controls (delete/exit/drag icons). Omit to inherit the parent theme's value -- most themes with a parent leave this unset.

imgDir.description: Root-relative path to this theme's image assets (e.g. 'themes/default/images'). Omit to inherit the parent theme's value.

mimeIconDir.description: Root-relative path to this theme's per-mimetype icon assets (e.g. 'themes/default/icon/mimetypes/'). Omit to inherit the parent theme's value.
